chapter: Trombone technique, plunger mute and the California years
title: Jabbo Smith's songs, the Hopkins band and Newport
summary: He and Jabbo were close friends in the Claude Hopkins band; he wants Jabbo's songs played and paid for, and discusses the Newport lineup.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: You and Jabboe (PHONETIC) went together in the Claude Hopkins band.
Yeah. We were pretty good tight friends, you know. Yeah. Jabroe has written some several good numbers and no one has ever tried to do them. I did a couple of them.

Yeah, that's a good one. I wanted to put them in several bands -- his numbers. I never can get with the guys to get the songs to them. You know, I -- I will though eventually. But I think he deserves to get some money for them songs he's written.
And the songs are just going to waste -- nobody is making no money off them and I think he should.
He's going to be at Newport this year -- you know that?

Yes, I know that. He and Bobby Hackett on the same bill. I don't know for sure if I'm going to be on it. I expected to be on it but if that's the way they want it that's their thing, you know. Ain't nothing to me.
Yeah. I don't think -- I saw Barney is on it I think -- Barney McCarthy. But I don't know whether that's everybody or just a few names --
Yeah, I don't know. I haven't heard anything though. The only thing I know that I'm going to Nice or supposedly. So I just don't know.
